observations: The REST endpoint redirects to _dialog_result.php with the same query string (final_url in each sidecar).

exp_dates is not an exact-name match: a filter on a short name also returned rows of a second experiment whose name begins with it (ratio_ekn_filtered.csv holds two experiments; observed once, matching rule not documented here); check EXP-NAME and SUBEXP-NAME of every row.
energy_start and energy_stop restrict the returned bins.
A filter that matches nothing returns HTTP 200 and an export with the full header and no data rows.
The export header lists the 2014, 2020 and 2023 CRDB papers and no release number.
